question: App provides "dark" and reads the theme in the same component. Why does it get the default?
options: The provider must be above App
useContext must be called after the JSX
say: App provides dark and reads the theme in the same component. Why does it get the default?
explanation: useContext looks only for providers above the calling component. It ignores providers returned by the same component.
explainSay: The provider has to be above App. Use context ignores providers in its own component.
